subject.title: [Bug] v2026.6.11 published dist missing reentrancy guard - reply session initialization conflicted

question: Should OpenClaw publish a stable hotfix/repack for the affected v2026.6.11 latest npm artifact now, rather than waiting for the next scheduled stable release?
rationale: The source fixes are already on main, but the action that resolves this issue is release/package handling and stable-user communication, which automation should not decide from source code alone.

options.title: Publish a stable hotfix
options.body: Cut a stable release or repack that includes the current reply-session fixes and a tarball parity smoke check, then close this issue against that release.

options.title: Wait for the next stable
options.body: Leave this issue open until the next stable release ships and explicitly document that v2026.6.11 latest is affected meanwhile.

options.title: Route users to a verified beta
options.body: If a beta is already proven fixed, update user-facing guidance while still keeping this issue open until stable latest is corrected.

recommendation.title: Publish a stable hotfix
recommendation.body: Cut a stable release or repack that includes the current reply-session fixes and a tarball parity smoke check, then close this issue against that release.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining blocker is stable release/package ownership, and Vincent Koc tagged the affected v2026.6.11 release.
